Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring mailed political advertising to be filed with the secretary of state to be archived.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the archiving of mailed political advertising;and adding a new section to chapter 42.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The sponsor of a mailed political advertising must, within twoworking days after the date of the mailing, file an example of themailed political advertising with the secretary of state for inclusionwith the state archives and records under chapter 40.14 RCW.
